responsibility: Declares the feasible_graph abstraction used during diagnostic path selection to explore feasible subtrees of the exploded graph. It defines feasible and infeasible node/edge wrappers around exploded nodes and edges, stores per-node feasibility_state and path length, and exposes APIs for adding explored states, recording rejected constraints, reconstructing feasible exploded paths, and dumping the resulting graph for debugging.
same_name_distinction: Declares the feasible-graph node, edge, and graph types and their public APIs; unlike feasible-graph.cc, it provides the type structure and interfaces for representing feasible and infeasible exploded-graph traversal states rather than the operational dumping and path-building logic.
